description.value: Sungiven Foods is a health-focused Asian grocery chain at City Square in Vancouver's Cambie corridor, emphasizing natural, less-processed products with fewer additives. The store carries a broad range of fresh produce, meat, seafood, dairy, packaged goods, beverages, and snacks, as well as its own Sungiven Kitchen line of prepared meals. It would serve touring cyclists well as a full resupply stop with quality fresh food options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the City Square location of Sungiven Foods at #42–555 W 12th Ave, Vancouver, matching the OSM address. The website provides a phone number (604.757.5588) not present in OSM tags. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site; the store's product categories (produce, dairy, meat, seafood, packaged goods, beverages, snacks) confirm it is a full grocery store.
